_note: Volunteer board (/volunteer/). Hand-kept. "ongoing": standing ways to help. An entry with "org" names a group in organizations.json and shows that group's howToHelp line, linked to its Community listing; an entry without "org" carries its own name, what, link, source and verified date. Give each a "kind": hands-on, donate, youth or seniors. "needs": specific, dated asks ({title, org, what, how, link, until: YYYY-MM-DD, source}); each hides itself after its "until" date. Events in events.json tagged "volunteer" also appear under Current asks until they end. Public organizational contacts only; never name volunteers or children.

ongoing.org: Waynesville Food Pantry and Wayne Township Community Aid

ongoing.name: RSVP volunteer program (55 and older)
ongoing.what: AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP of Warren County matches volunteers 55 and older with local nonprofits: packing food for the hungry, tutoring, visiting isolated older adults, hospice, early learning centers and adult literacy.
ongoing.how: Download the membership form from the RSVP page and mail it to RSVP, 645 Oak Street, Lebanon.

ongoing.name: Warren County Community Services volunteers
ongoing.what: Lead activities at the 741 senior center, help in early learning classrooms or with the grounds, or tutor adults in reading and English (training provided).
ongoing.how: See the volunteer page for each program.
